title: MiniMax Code local plugin manifest
description: The subset of the plugin manifest format used by the plugins in this repository. MiniMax Code reads the manifest itself; this schema exists so editors and contributors can validate a change before installing it.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, relative to the manifest.

schemaVersion.description: The manifest format version. MiniMax Code 0.6.12 and newer read version 1.

name.description: The plugin's identifier. Also the directory name under ~/.minimax/plugins/.

displayName.description: The name shown in the plugin list.

description.description: One or two sentences, shown in the plugin list and used for discovery.

icon.description: Path to a .webp icon, relative to the manifest.

category.description: The marketplace category. A plugin with an unknown category is skipped silently.

exampleQueries.description: Example prompts. A manifest with none of these is skipped silently.

mcpServers.description: Paths to MCP server definitions, relative to the manifest.

skills.description: Paths to SKILL.md files, relative to the manifest.

hooks.description: Paths to hook definitions, relative to the manifest.
